title: Multi-Agent Coordinated Rename Refactoring
abstract: arXiv:2601.00482v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: The primary value of AI agents in software development lies in their ability to extend the developer's capacity for reasoning and action, not to supplant human involvement. To showcase how to use agents working in tandem with developers, we designed a novel approach for carrying out coordinated renaming. Coordinated renaming, where a single rename refactoring triggers refactorings in multiple, related identifiers, is a frequent yet challenging task. Developers must manually propagate these rename refactorings across numerous files and contexts, a process that is both tedious and highly error-prone. State-of-the-art heuristic-based approaches produce an overwhelming number of false positives, while vanilla Large Language Models (LLMs) provide incomplete suggestions due to their limited context and inability to interact with refactoring tools. This leaves developers with incomplete refactorings or burdens them with filtering too

translated_title: 多智能体协同重命名重构
translated_abstract: AI智能体在软件开发中的主要价值在于其能够扩展开发者的推理与行动能力，而非取代人类的参与。为了展示如何让智能体与开发者协同工作，我们设计了一种新颖的协同重命名执行方法。协同重命名是指一次重命名重构会触发多个相关标识符的重构，这是一项常见但具有挑战性的任务。开发者必须手动将这些重命名重构传播到众多文件和上下文中，这一过程既繁琐又极易出错。最先进的基于启发式的方法会产生大量令人难以承受的误报，而普通的大语言模型（LLM）由于其上下文有限且无法与重构工具交互，只能提供不完整的建议。这使得开发者要么面对不完整的重构结果，要么背负过滤过多建议的沉重负担……
tldr: 该论文提出了一种多智能体协同方法来执行重命名重构，让AI智能体与开发者协作完成跨多个相关标识符的协同重命名，克服了传统启发式方法误报过多和普通大语言模型建议不完整的问题。
